messages:
sam: Heads-up — ACME POC kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. Need a quick runbook for provisioning access: hosted API keys for devs, a small Dedicated pool for load tests, and steps for VPC peering for their security team. Can @mira and @alex take point?

mira: I can own the API key + test harness. What QPS / concurrency should we size the Dedicated pool for?

sam: Goal is 50 concurrent users, peak 120 QPS on text-gen with 1.2k token avg. P95 latency target ~300ms. It's a short POC (3 weeks).

alex: For 120 QPS with that token length I'd recommend 1 x p4d-small equivalent (dedicated 2-gpu pool) with autoscale + burst to 2 nodes. That keeps latency in range and is cheap for short term.

mira: Great. I'll draft the onboarding checklist. Quick note on hosted API keys: for POC we create team-scoped API keys with read/write scopes and rotate after POC. Example command for devs to test:

```
export REDWOOD_KEY=<KEY>
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"hello"}'
```

mira: I'll also provide Postman collection and a short node script.

jordan: For VPC peering, security asked for a minimal runbook: we need their public ASN, CIDR ranges, and whether they'll accept AWS Transit Gateway or direct VPC peering. Also confirm whether traffic is encrypted end-to-end (we support TLS + optional IPsec on Private).

sam: They've given 10.10.0.0/16 as customer CIDR and want TGW. I'll email those details to @jordan later today.

alex: Internal provisioning steps (ops runbook excerpt):

```
# create dedicated pool (internal CLI)
rwdctl pools create --name acme-poc --model redwood-alpha-1 --gpus 2 --min-replicas 1 --max-replicas 2 --tags poc,acme
# grant team access
rwdctl teams grant acme-team --resource pools/acme-poc --role developer
```

alex: Portal link for manual: https://console.redwood.ai/internal/pools/acme-poc (use SSO)

mira: I'll attach a short checklist for the sales rep to send to the customer (what we need from them):
- AWS account ID and preferred region (string)
- Transit Gateway ARN or confirmation for peering
- Customer CIDRs
- List of users who need API keys + emails
- Any IP allowlist entries they require

sam: Pricing question from legal: can we offer a temporary POC rate? They asked about a one-month trial with limited commit.

alex: For short POCs we typically do a trial offer: no commit on Hosted, and a discounted 50% off first month on Dedicated committed rate (internal promo POC50). I'll confirm with finance, but that's the standard.

jordan: Security questionnaire note: for Private (VPC) deployment we need to answer AES-256 at rest, KMS integration, and whether logs can be routed to their CloudWatch/S3. I'll prepare those answers.

mira: I'll compile a single PDF packet: how-to, API key instructions, sample requests, Postman + node script, and the ops CLI snippet. Will drop in the deal record.

sam: Thanks — timeline: mira to share packet by EOD, alex to provision pool once IAM approvals are done, jordan to prep security answers. I'll own customer comms and pricing.

deploy-bot: Pool provisioning started for pools/acme-poc. Job ID: j-9a8f2. Status: queued. :robot_face:

deploy-bot: Pool pools/acme-poc is now ACTIVE. Endpoint: https://acme-poc.re.redwood.ai — creds in vault. :tada:

mira: Verified basic smoke test against the endpoint. Latency looks fine. I pushed Postman collection to the deal workspace. :white_check_mark: 

sam: Perfect — I'll run through the pricing terms and email ACME legal. If anything blocks (security or network) we escalate to @jordan and @alex. Thanks team!
